title: Workdays Calculator – Number of Workdays Between Two Dates (Weekends & Holidays Excluded)
shortDescription: Count the number of workdays between two dates, not including weekends and holidays. Pick a US, UK, Japan or Germany holiday preset or paste your own list; Saturday or Sunday can be counted as workdays.
description: Enter a start and end date to get the total number of workdays (business days) between them, with weekends and public holidays excluded and both dates counted. Example: 1 Aug 2026 to 31 Jul 2027 is 365 calendar days, 260 Monday–Friday days, and 249 workdays after the US federal holiday preset. To find the date N workdays after a start date, use the Date Calculator's business-day mode.

sections.heading: Worked examples: number of workdays between two dates
paragraphs: A typical contract or payroll question looks like 'total workdays between 1 August 2026 and 31 July 2027'. The range is 365 calendar days. 260 of them are Monday–Friday. With the US federal holiday preset, 11 holidays fall on weekdays, so the answer is 249 workdays. With no holidays selected the tool reports 260.

Shorter ranges work the same way. 25 August 2026 to 30 January 2027 is 159 calendar days, 114 weekdays, and 107 workdays once the 7 US federal holidays in that span (Labor Day through Martin Luther King Jr. Day) are removed. 1 October 2026 to 31 December 2026 is 92 days, 66 weekdays, and 62 workdays after Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

If your country or company observes different holidays, choose 'None' in the preset and paste the dates you need. The counts update instantly, and the 'Holidays' line in the result shows how many listed dates actually fell on a weekday inside the range.

sections.heading: Why workday counting matters
paragraphs: Project deadlines, contract terms, payroll cycles, and leave planning all use 'business days' rather than calendar days. A delivery promise of 30 business days made on a Friday is actually 42 calendar days because weekends don't count. Mistaking the two leads to missed deadlines and contract disputes.

Workdays also matter for legal counting: in many jurisdictions, statutory time limits (e.g., '14 business days to respond') exclude weekends and public holidays. Always check whether 'days' means calendar or business in any agreement.

sections.heading: Why we let you customize weekends
paragraphs: Most countries use Saturday-Sunday as the weekend, but it varies. Most Middle Eastern and some North African countries observe Friday-Saturday as the weekend. Some industries (retail, hospitality) consider weekends as workdays.
Our toggles let you mark Saturday or Sunday as workdays individually. So you can configure: Mon-Fri only (default), 6-day work week (include Saturday), or even Sunday-only weekend (uncheck Sunday).

sections.heading: How to use the holidays input
paragraphs: Paste a list of dates in YYYY-MM-DD format (ISO 8601). Separators can be commas, spaces, or newlines. Each date you list will be excluded from the workday count if it falls on what would otherwise be a workday.

The holiday preset above covers the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom (England & Wales) and Germany for 2026–2027. For other countries, regional holidays or company closures, list the dates here — they are added on top of the preset.

faq.q: How many workdays are between two dates?
faq.a: Enter both dates: the calculator counts every Monday–Friday in the range (start and end included), then subtracts the public holidays from the preset you pick and any dates you list. Example: July 1–31, 2026 has 23 weekdays; with the US federal holiday preset (Independence Day observed on Friday, July 3) it is 22 workdays.

faq.q: How do I count work days not including weekends and holidays?
faq.a: Pick a start date and an end date, then choose a holiday preset (United States, Japan, United Kingdom or Germany) or paste your own holiday dates. The 'Workdays' result is the number of Monday–Friday days in the range minus any listed holidays that fall on a weekday. Weekend days and holidays are shown separately so you can check the breakdown.

faq.q: How many workdays are there between 1 June 2026 and 31 May 2027?
faq.a: 365 calendar days, of which 261 are Monday–Friday. With the US federal holiday preset (Juneteenth 2026 through Memorial Day 2027, 11 weekday holidays) the result is 250 workdays. Other presets give different totals: run the same dates with the UK, Japan or Germany preset to compare.

faq.q: How do I find the date that is N workdays after a start date?
faq.a: This page counts workdays between two known dates. To go the other way — for example '30 workdays from July 16, 2026' — use the Date Calculator (linked below the tool): turn on business-day mode and pick the same public-holiday preset (US, Japan, UK or Germany, 2026–2027); it skips weekends and those holidays and lists the holidays it skipped. Dates you typed in this page's own holiday list are not carried over, so move that result forward one workday for each such extra day off. To double-check, count here from the day after your start date to the result — it should equal N.

faq.q: Are start and end dates inclusive?
faq.a: Yes. If both are workdays, both are counted. If your contract counts only the days between (exclusive), subtract 2 from the result.

Only if you pick a preset: built-in data covers public holidays in the United States, Japan, the United Kingdom (England & Wales) and Germany for 2026–2027. Holidays vary by country, region and year, so for anywhere else — or for company-specific days off — add the dates manually; they are combined with the preset.

faq.q: Can I use this for international contracts?
faq.a: Yes — but make sure both parties agree on which holidays to count. Multinational contracts often specify 'business days as observed in the [city] of [country]' to avoid ambiguity.

faq.q: What if a holiday falls on a weekend?
faq.a: It's not double-counted. If 2026-01-01 is a Thursday holiday, it's counted as a holiday. If 2027-12-25 falls on a Saturday, the algorithm correctly counts it as one day (weekend), not two.

faq.q: How does this work for a 6-day work week?
faq.a: Check 'Saturday is a workday'. The calculator will count Mon-Sat as workdays and only exclude Sundays and listed holidays.

faq.q: What's the maximum date range I can compute?
faq.a: Hundreds of years at minimum. The browser handles date arithmetic up to ±100 million days from 1970.

faq.q: Can I export the workday list?
faq.a: Not as a download, but you can copy the displayed numbers. For a per-day list, a spreadsheet is more flexible.

faq.q: Does the data leave my browser?
faq.a: No. Everything runs locally; nothing is sent to a server.
